import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' and 'time' to datetime
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot of total sales by product and size
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
product_size_sales = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack()
product_size_sales.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, colormap='viridis', ax=plt.gca())

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Size', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Size', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' and 'time' to datetime
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot of total sales by product and size
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
product_size_sales = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack()
product_size_sales.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, colormap='viridis', ax=plt.gca())

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Size', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Size', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
